'''Toola''' was a cold [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Kaelta system]]. It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]] and was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].

==Description==
Toola occupied a slightly elliptic [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Kaelta]]<ref name="J10" /> in the [[Kaelta system]],<ref name="UAA" /> which was itself located in the [[Nilgaard sector/Legends|Nilgaard sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Toola was also within the region known as the [[The Slice/Legends|Slice]] and was situated on the [[Overic Griplink/Legends|Overic Griplink]], which connected it to [[Quermia/Legends|Quermia]] and [[Pakuuni/Legends|Pakuuni]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

Toola was a terrestrial world with a breathable<ref name="J10" /> but thin [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]],<ref name="GG4">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref> standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], a cool climate, and a moist hydrosphere. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Toola lasted 23 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], and a year consisted of 423 local days.<ref name="J10" /> Toola owed its cold conditions to its thin atmosphere and its distance from Kaelta,<ref name="GG4" /> and due to its oblong orbit, the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] experienced winter for most of its [[Standard year/Legends|year]]; summer lasted less than one-fifth of the year and only caused warming in tropical regions. During summer, herd animals increased in number,<ref name="J10" /> vegetation grew, and [[Water/Legends|snow]] melted.<ref name="UAA" />

Toola's terrain included frozen ocean, tundra, glacier-encrusted mountains surrounded by windswept ice plains, and regions of snowy [[Desert/Legends|desert]] covered by shifting snow dunes. In some isolated areas, hot springs, created when subterranean pools of water were heated by the core of the planet, burst out of the ground, providing a source of heat.<ref name="J10" />

Toola's equatorial regions supported ninety percent of its lifeforms, including [[snow demon]]s, [[arabore]]s, [[caraboose]], [[Tuggle/Legends|tuggles]], and [[Mastmot/Legends|mastmots]]. Snow demons were dangerous predators that hunted on the world's ice fields.<ref name="J10" /> [[Grass/Legends|Grasses]] grew on Toola during summer. Caraboose and mastmots grazed on the plains during the summer,<ref name="GG4" /> and the two would also join tuggles and snow demons in peacefully gathering around hot springs to warm themselves and drink melted water.<ref name="J10" />

Toola featured a tribal system of government and exported furs, tusks, and ice,<ref name="J10" /> which some [[Species/Legends|species]] from arid planets visited Toola to harvest. At one point, ice was the planet's only export.<ref name="GG4" /> While the world imported low technology, it never developed a technological base, even after it came into contact with the outside galaxy.<ref name="J10" />

==History==
[[File:BattleofToola.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Toola was the site of a battle during the Clone Wars.]]
During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Toola aligned with the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Toola was allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="The Essential Atlas" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Battle of Toola]] was fought there. Later that year, Jedi Master [[Simms]] was killed there as part of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. [[Ithaqua Station]] was a port on Toola well-known for holding [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitives after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued, including the [[Last Curator of Records]]. The Jedi [[K'Kruhk]] came from Toola.

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] visited Toola in search of information on past Jedi. However, all he found was a despoiled Jedi archive and a deceased Jedi Master's robes and lightsaber. In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], [[Ch'Unkk]] was head of Toola's largest clan.

Following the [[Massacre at Ossus]], Jedi Master K'Kruhk went into hiding on the ice world, returning to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later.

==Inhabitants==
Toola's population consisted of 8.4 million [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings. The [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphids]], a tusked and furred species of sentient predators, were native to Toola.<ref name="J10" /> Most Whiphids living on Toola possessed thicker [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and more body fat than those found elsewhere.<ref name="GG4" /> Traders from off-world could also be found on Toola.<ref name="J10" />

==Locations==
[[File:Ithaqua_central_market.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The central market in Ithaqua Station]]
Toola was the site of at least one [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and a landing field. A few small trading posts, which were the Whiphids' primary source of contact with the outside galaxy, were located close to the planet's equator and near hot springs.<ref name="J10" />
